description: Historische geografie - sluizen is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Bestand met verdwenen en huidige sluizen almede het type sluis. Sluizen, of zijlen, zijn kunstmatige waterlozingspunten en punten voor watertoevoer. De bouw ervan hangt samen met het afsluiten van gebieden van het boezem- of zeewater door middel van dijken. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are cultuurhistorie, dijken, sluizen, waterwegen. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JPEG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2025-04-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
